coupling_convention: Initial misalignment angle Theta_0 (dimensionless), exactly as plotted on the y-axis of Fig. 3 versus m_A (converted from micro-eV to eV on x-axis); region above the curve overproduces axion dark matter
notes: Lattice QCD calculation (Borsanyi et al. 2016, arXiv:1606.07494) of the QCD equation of state and topological susceptibility chi(T), used to predict the dark matter axion mass in the f_A-m_A plane. Post-inflation scenario gives a strict lower bound m_A = 28(2) ueV (theta_0 = 2.155), m_A = 50(4) ueV if misalignment contributes 50% of DM, and a final estimated range m_A = 50-1500 ueV (upper end assumes only 1% misalignment contribution, remainder from topological defects/strings). Data points converted from stated m_A values to (f_A, m_A) pairs using m_A*f_A = chi(0)^{1/2} = (75.6 MeV)^2. This is a cosmological/theoretical bound on the f_a-m_a plane, not a laboratory exclusion; no DM density assumption in the haloscope sense (relic abundance Omega_DM is the constraint).
